async def act(page):
    import asyncio
    # Click the 'Use template' radio button for the Express template to select it
    # Use filter to find the radio associated with the Express preview link
    await page.get_by_role('radio', name='Use template').filter(
        has=page.get_by_role('link', name='Preview', url='https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/project-templates/express')
    ).click()
    # Wait for the UI to update after selection
    await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
    await asyncio.sleep(3)  # Additional wait to ensure form loads
